D3 = docs/222 §11.5 bar G3 'whole stack' (never measured) as P3 'price what ships': the shipped stack (master ON defaults) against ourMods false (community layer only), separate-load ABBA per world (off-1, on-1, on-2, off-2; BP then IP), 10 min each, seed 12345, light tools only (noSamplers, no fixedwork / A/B switch: X4 needs ts3native, so it cannot run in the off arm). NEEDS A QUIET MACHINE (clean night): 8 jobs ~2 h with load gaps. Per-arm ms/s split: arm-ms.ts pools the -off-N / -on-N jobs of each world as one group (abbaOf) and prints script, route, animPose, locomotion ms/s per arm and on - off; read also Threaded ms/iter and it/s (hitch-ab.ts 'all' arm per job; the sim runs flat out, so a cost shows as fewer iterations as well as ms/s, docs/222 §11.5 fixed-work note). Report row: node tools/harness/arm-ms.ts mono-measure-g3stack-1115-<date>-bp-g3stack mono-measure-g3stack-1115-<date>-ip-g3stack --json -> the G3 row of docs/222 §11.5 (on - off ms/s and it/s per world; G3 passes for go-live when on - off <= 0 ms/s, and the release-number table gets 'stack cost vs community layer' from the same tags via release-numbers.ts --vanilla <off tags> --rel <on tags>). Household Sims: the on arm runs only shipped defaults (each already exempts the household); the off arm runs no mod code. Bin as found: the queue never changes Bin (no Apex unless it is installed; an Apex G3 pair needs the chain script the memdiag3 Apex job used). Start: node tools/harness/queue.ts tools/harness/queues/mono-measure-g3stack-1115.json (smoke runs first, >60 timing minutes).
